user.title: OpenDTU Zero-Export EMS
user.description:
The EMS itself is a single Home Assistant **package** file. Setup installs it as `{package}` and the ready-made dashboard view as `{dashboard}`.

An existing file is only replaced when it is **older**: the old file is kept as a `.bak` copy, a file from a newer release and a locally edited file at the same version are left untouched.

Afterwards **restart Home Assistant** so the entities (sensors, helpers, automations) are created.

data.install: Install and update the files in the configuration folder

abort.already_configured: The OpenDTU Zero-Export EMS is already set up.

install_bundle.name: Install bundle
install_bundle.description: Re-install the packaged EMS YAML file and the dashboard view into the configuration folder, overwriting them and keeping a `.bak` copy.
